Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At the concert hall, a 70-year-old grabbed a seat in the back while their grandchild asked for a seat in the front. The grandchild wanted to sit closer to the front because of having recently started experiencing some loss of hearing, and the 70-year-old agreed just to be supportive. Who was hearing impaired?
A. The 70-year-old
B. Not enough info
C. The grandchild
